feather-title: Name of the tool. Do not translate unless the community uses a translated name.
feather-subtitle: Sub-heading describing the tool platform purpose.
feather-nav-home: Navigation link to the tool front page.
feather-nav-create-contest: Navigation action button to launch new contest creation.
feather-nav-login: Action button linking to Wikimedia OAuth login.
feather-nav-logout: Action button logging the current user out.
feather-nav-session-checking: Loading text displayed while checking active session cookie.
feather-nav-dashboard: Navigation link to a contest overview dashboard.
feather-nav-submit: Navigation link to bulk submit articles.
feather-nav-review-queue: Navigation link to jury review workspace.
feather-nav-back-contests: Back link to return to the contests list.
feather-contests-heading: Page header title for competitions list.
feather-app-login-banner: Notice banner prompting users to log in with Wikimedia account.
feather-app-login-btn: Button label to initiate Wikimedia OAuth login.
feather-app-logged-as: Status indicator showing logged in user. $1 is username.
feather-contest-action-submit: Primary action button on contest card to submit articles.
feather-contest-action-review: Secondary action button to open jury review queue.
feather-contest-action-standings: Action button to view contest standings.
feather-contest-days-left: Badge showing days remaining in contest. $1 is number of days.
feather-contest-filter-all-wikis: Option in wiki filter dropdown to show all wikis.
feather-contests-empty: Empty state text shown when no contests are active.
feather-contest-status-active: Status badge: contest is currently running.
feather-contest-status-draft: Status badge: contest is still in draft.
feather-contest-submitted: Metric label for submitted articles count.
feather-contest-accepted: Metric label for accepted articles count.
feather-contest-pending: Metric label for articles awaiting jury review.
feather-contest-participants: Metric label for total unique participants.
feather-contest-ends: Shows competition end date. $1 is the formatted date.
feather-contest-min-words: Rule tag showing minimum words requirement. $1 is the number.
feather-contest-min-bytes: Rule tag showing minimum bytes requirement. $1 is the number.
feather-contest-must-creator: Rule tag indicating user must be the page creator.
feather-standings-ranked-by: Caption explaining sorting order (accepted articles count).
feather-standings-col-words: Table header for total words count.
feather-standings-col-bytes: Table header for total bytes count.
feather-standings-col-submitted: Table header for total submitted count.
feather-standings-empty: Empty state text for leaderboard when no submissions exist.
feather-create-heading: Page title for contest creation form.
feather-create-subheading: Description below contest creation form title.
feather-create-sec-general: Section title for general contest details.
feather-create-code-label: Form label for contest URL code/slug.
feather-create-sec-wiki: Section title for wiki target and timeframe.
feather-create-wiki-preset: Label for quick target wiki selector.
feather-create-wiki-url-label: Form label for target wiki URL.
feather-create-wiki-dbname-label: Form label for target wiki database name.
feather-create-start-date: Form label for contest start datetime.
feather-create-end-date: Form label for contest end datetime.
feather-create-sec-rules: Section title for Fountain qualification rules.
feather-create-min-words-label: Label for minimum word count rule.
feather-create-min-bytes-label: Label for minimum byte length rule.
feather-create-min-refs-label: Label for minimum citation references rule.
feather-create-rule-creator: Toggle label for requiring submitter to be original page creator.
feather-create-rule-redirect: Toggle label for disallowing redirect pages.
feather-create-rule-disambig: Toggle label for disallowing disambiguation pages.
feather-create-rule-window: Toggle label for enforcing article creation inside date window.
feather-create-rule-self-review: Toggle label for allowing juries to self-review.
feather-create-max-submissions: Label for maximum submissions per user cap.
feather-create-sec-jury: Section title for jury team assignment.
feather-create-sec-automation: Section title for talk-page template bot automation.
feather-create-add-template: Toggle label for talk-page template notices.
feather-create-add-template-hint: Explanation of throttled talk-page edit queue.
feather-create-template-name: Form label for talk-page template name.
feather-create-submit-btn: Button label to submit contest creation form.
feather-create-creating-btn: Button label while contest is being created.
feather-create-success: Toast notification when contest is created. $1 is the contest name.
feather-review-title: Header title of the jury review queue.
feather-review-loaded: Count badge of loaded articles in queue. $1 is the count.
feather-review-live-preview: Label for live MediaWiki rendered preview.
feather-review-open-wiki: Link label to open article directly on wiki.
feather-submit-subheading: Subheading on submission portal. $1 is contest name.
feather-submit-detected-count: Counter for parsed titles. $1 is count.
feather-submit-btn: Button to submit entries. $1 is count.
feather-submit-success: Toast notification on successful submission. $1 is count.
feather-home-search-placeholder: Placeholder text in the search input on the home page.
feather-home-filter-all: Filter button label to show all contests.
feather-home-filter-active: Filter button label to show active contests.
feather-home-filter-ended: Filter button label to show ended contests.
feather-home-stats-contests: Label for total contests metric card on home page.
feather-home-stats-articles: Label for total article submissions metric card on home page.
feather-home-stats-accepted: Label for total accepted articles metric card on home page.
feather-home-stats-juries: Label for active juries metric card on home page.
feather-home-quick-submit: Quick action button label to submit articles to a contest.
feather-home-quick-review: Quick action button label for juries to review articles.
feather-home-quick-standings: Quick action button label to view contest standings.
feather-home-clear-filters: Button label to reset all search inputs and status filters.
feather-home-search-empty-title: Title message when search returns zero contests.
feather-home-search-empty-desc: Description text when search yields no matches. $1 is search term.
feather-home-rate-accepted: Label for percentage of submitted articles accepted.
feather-sort-by: Label for sorting dropdown or controls.
feather-sort-project: Sort option: alphabetically by Wikimedia project target.
feather-sort-language: Sort option: by wiki language code.
feather-sort-submissions: Sort option: by highest volume of submitted articles.
feather-filter-project: Filter dropdown label for target wiki project.
feather-filter-language: Filter dropdown label for wiki language.
feather-filter-all-projects: Option to show all Wikimedia projects.
feather-time-remaining: Label for progress bar tracking time elapsed in contest window.
feather-time-elapsed: Percentage indicator for contest duration elapsed. $1 is percent.
feather-search-specific-comp: Placeholder in search box for finding specific competitions.
feather-contest-not-found: Title when contest code is invalid or not found in database.
feather-contest-rule-creator-badge: Badge indicating that page creator rule applies.
feather-contest-standings-empty: Empty state text for standings table.
feather-contest-calculating-standings: Loading state while standings are calculated.
feather-contest-tab-submissions: Tab label for all submissions list.
feather-contest-tab-rules: Tab label for rules and eligibility criteria.
feather-contest-export-wikitext: Button label to open wikitext export dialog.
feather-contest-export-wikitext-title: Dialog title for wikitext standings exporter.
feather-contest-export-wikitext-desc: Help text explaining how to paste exported wikitext table.
feather-contest-copy-wikitext: Button to copy generated wikitext table.
feather-contest-copy-link: Button label to copy contest URL.
feather-contest-link-copied: Toast confirmation after copying contest link.
feather-contest-search-participants: Search input placeholder for standings filter.
feather-contest-search-articles: Search input placeholder for articles filter.
feather-contest-filter-all: Filter option to show all submission statuses.
feather-contest-filter-failed: Filter option for validation failed articles.
feather-contest-rule-window-desc: Description for creation date window rule.
feather-contest-rule-namespace-desc: Description for main article namespace rule.
feather-contest-rule-talk-template-desc: Description for talk page template notification.
feather-contest-juries-empty: Empty state when no juries are configured.
feather-contest-submissions-empty: Empty state when no articles have been submitted.
feather-contest-col-article: Table column header for article title.
feather-contest-col-words: Table column header for word count.
feather-contest-col-bytes: Table column header for byte count.
feather-contest-col-date: Table column header for submission date.
feather-contest-timeline-progress: Aria label / text for contest timeline percentage.
feather-contest-days-left-count: Text showing days remaining in contest.
feather-submit-req-body: Body text explaining requirements for article submissions.
feather-submit-enter-username-err: Validation toast error when username is missing.
feather-submit-enter-title-err: Validation toast error when titles textarea is empty.
feather-create-cancel: Cancel button on contest creation page.
feather-create-name-required: Error message when contest name is omitted.
feather-action-view: Button label to view contest dashboard.
feather-submit-behalf-toggle: Label for submitting on behalf of another participant.
feather-submit-card-title: Title for fetched articles card. $1 is username.
feather-submit-card-desc: Description showing date window. $1 is start date, $2 is end date.
feather-submit-fetch-btn: Button label to fetch articles created by the user.
feather-submit-fetching: Loading state label for fetch button.
feather-submit-search-articles: Placeholder for filtering fetched articles in-page.
feather-submit-can-submit-section: Header for available articles section. $1 is count.
feather-submit-already-submitted-section: Header for already submitted articles section. $1 is count.
feather-submit-selected-count: Badge showing number of selected articles. $1 is count.
feather-submit-select-all: Option to select all available articles.
feather-submit-select-custom: Option to select a custom number of articles.
feather-submit-sort-date: Label for sorting by creation date.
feather-submit-deselect-all: Action button to uncheck all articles.
feather-submit-manual-tab: Tab label for manual title entry mode.
feather-submit-auto-tab: Tab label for auto-detected articles mode.
feather-submit-manual-placeholder: Textarea placeholder for manual title entry.
feather-submit-no-articles-found: Message when user has created 0 articles in contest window.
feather-submit-all-already-submitted: Message when all created articles have already been submitted.
feather-submit-no-search-match: Message when in-page search yields 0 matches. $1 is query.
feather-submit-submitting-progress: Progress text during submission batching. $1 is processed, $2 is total, $3 is percent.
feather-submit-btn-action: Main button to submit selected articles. $1 is count.
feather-submit-results-desc: Summary of processed articles in submission batch. $1 is count.
feather-submit-col-title: Table column header for article title.
feather-submit-col-status: Table column header for submission validation status.
feather-submit-col-details: Table column header for error details or success message.
feather-submit-status-submitted: Status badge label for successfully submitted article.
feather-submit-status-error: Status badge label for validation failed article.
feather-submit-window-ended: Alert message when contest end date has passed.
feather-submit-window-not-open: Alert message when contest start date is in the future.
feather-footer-tagline: Tagline explaining the purpose of Feather and Bangla WikiConnect.
feather-footer-license-prefix: Prefix before license link in MediaWiki-style footer.
feather-footer-license-suffix: Suffix after license link in footer.
feather-footer-wmcs-credit: WMCS hosting and powering credit label.
feather-footer-link-about: Link label for about page or project.
feather-footer-link-developers: Link label for developers / source repository.
feather-footer-link-issues: Link label for reporting issues / feedback.
feather-footer-link-coc: Link label for code of conduct.
feather-footer-badge-wmcs: Alt text and label for Powered by Wikimedia Cloud Services badge.
